alias: Whole House: the Show's volume buttons move the HomePod too
description: While Music Assistant's Whole House group (Kitchen Echo + HomePod) is playing or paused, the Kitchen Echo's own volume buttons change only the Echo. This follows each change on the HomePod in proportion, as the group's own volume does (Echo 53 -> 86 takes the HomePod 30 -> 49). Only right after a press of the Echo's buttons (within 3 s), so a change made through the group itself, which already moves both, isn't applied twice. Ty, 2026-11-03.

conditions.value_template: {% set t = [states('event.kitchen_volume_up_button'), states('event.kitchen_volume_down_button')] | map('as_datetime', none) | reject('none') | list %}{{ t | count > 0 and (now() - (t | max)).total_seconds() < 3 }}
{{ trigger.from_state.attributes.volume_level is number and trigger.to_state.attributes.volume_level is number }}

variables.target: {{ ([([homepod * new / old if old > 0 else homepod + new - old, 0] | max), 1] | min) | round(2) }}
